Bertha Lutz.en: “…become capable of fulfilling the political duties that the future cannot fail to share with her.”
Bertha Lutz.zh: 「……有能力担起未来终将与她分享的政治职责。」

Begum Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain.en: “We dive deep into the ocean of knowledge”

Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz.en: “Had Aristotle cooked, he would have written a great deal more.”
Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz.zh: 「倘若亚里士多德下过厨房，他会写得多得多。」

Clara Zetkin.en: “The indispensable condition for this economic independence is work.”
Clara Zetkin.zh: 「这种经济独立不可或缺的条件，是劳动。」

Elizabeth Garrett Anderson.en: “Women can less easily afford to be second-rate.”

Lin Qiaozhi.en: “A doctor on duty for a lifetime.”

Olympe de Gouges.en: “Woman has the right to mount the scaffold; she must equally have the right to mount the rostrum.”
Olympe de Gouges.zh: 「女人既有走上断头台的权利，就同样应有登上讲坛的权利。」

Huda Sha'arawi.en: “In moments of danger, when women emerge by their side, men utter no protest. Yet … men refuse to see the capabilities of women.”
Huda Sha'arawi.zh: 「危难之时，女人挺身与男人并肩，男人并不反对。然而……男人却拒绝看见女人的能力。」

Kate Sheppard.en: “All that separates, whether of race, class, creed, or sex, is inhuman, and must be overcome.”
Kate Sheppard.zh: 「凡是造成隔阂的东西，无论出于种族、阶级、信仰还是性别，都是不人道的，必须克服。」

Shirley Chisholm.en: “I am the candidate of the people of America.”

Lin Huiyin.en: “The answer is long; I shall spend my whole life answering it.”
Lin Huiyin.zh: 「答案很长，我得用一生的时间来回答。」

Ruth Bader Ginsburg.en: “Women belong in all places where decisions are being made.”
Ruth Bader Ginsburg.zh: 「凡是做决定的地方，都应该有女性。」

Marie Curie.en: “Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.”
Marie Curie.zh: 「生活中没有什么可怕的东西，只有需要理解的东西。」

Ada Lovelace.en: “That brain of mine is something more than merely mortal, as time will show.”
Ada Lovelace.zh: 「我的头脑远不止凡俗——时间会证明。」

Hypatia.en: “To teach superstitions as truth is a most terrible thing.”
Hypatia.zh: 「将迷信当作真理来教授，是最可怕的事。」

Wu Zetian.en: “A wordless stele: let later generations be my judge.”
Wu Zetian.zh: 「无字碑——功过是非，留与后人评说。」

Frida Kahlo.en: “Feet, what do I need you for when I have wings to fly?”
Frida Kahlo.zh: 「脚啊，我有翅膀可飞，还要你做什么？」

Wangari Maathai.en: “Until you dig a hole, you plant a tree, you water it and make it survive, you haven't done a thing. You are just talking.”
Wangari Maathai.zh: 「在你挖好坑、种下树、浇上水、让它活下来之前，你什么都还没做——你只是在说。」

Rosalind Franklin.en: “We are not going to speculate, we are going to wait, we are going to let the spots on this photograph tell us what the structure is.”
Rosalind Franklin.zh: 「我们不猜测，我们等待，让这张照片上的斑点告诉我们结构是什么。」

Emmeline Pankhurst.en: “We are here not because we are law-breakers; we are here in our efforts to become law-makers.”
Emmeline Pankhurst.zh: 「我们在这里，不是因为我们违法；而是因为我们在努力成为立法者。」

Benazir Bhutto.en: “You can imprison a man, but not an idea. You can exile a man, but not an idea. You can kill a man, but not an idea.”
Benazir Bhutto.zh: 「你可以囚禁一个人，但囚不住一个想法。你可以流放一个人，但流放不了一个想法。你可以杀死一个人，但杀不死一个想法。」

Harriet Tubman.en: “I never ran my train off the track and I never lost a passenger.”
Harriet Tubman.zh: 「我的列车从未脱轨，我从未丢失一名乘客。」

Simone de Beauvoir.en: “One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman.”
Simone de Beauvoir.zh: 「一个人不是生为女人，而是变成女人的。」

Maya Angelou.en: “There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.”
Maya Angelou.zh: 「没有什么痛苦比心中藏着一个无人知晓的故事更深。」

Artemisia Gentileschi.en: “This is the ring you give me, and these are your promises.”
Artemisia Gentileschi.zh: 「这就是你给我的戒指，这就是你的承诺。」

Amelia Earhart.en: “The most effective way to do it is to do it.”
Amelia Earhart.zh: 「做一件事最有效的方式，就是去做。」

Junko Tabei.en: “Do not give up. Keep on your quest.”

Florence Nightingale.en: “I attribute my success to this: I never gave or took any excuse.”
Florence Nightingale.zh: 「我将成功归于一点：我从不找借口，也从不接受借口。」

Mary Wollstonecraft.en: “I do not wish women to have power over men, but over themselves.”
Mary Wollstonecraft.zh: 「我不希望女人拥有凌驾于男人之上的权力，而是拥有掌控自己的权力。」
